A scenario for the NPDB: estimated dry colour and soil climate

Source: R/npdb-scenario.R
npdb_scenario.Rd

Adds to NPDB pedons what the records lack and the Canadian key reads for the Chernozems (and the Gray Brown Luvisols and some subgroups), each as a range, for benchmark_npdb:

  • the dry value and chroma of the A horizons that record a moist colour and no dry one, from dry_colour (a npdb_dry_colour_model), with the range of its error;

  • the mean annual soil temperature, as the range of npdb_soil_climate (from the air temperature to 4 degrees above it; kept as a range only where it crosses 0 or 8 degrees, the limits the key reads), and the moisture subclass by Thornthwaite, with the subclass by Hargreaves and every subclass in between where they differ.

The pedons hold the central estimate (the middle of the soil temperature range) in the usual fields (munsell_value_dry, munsell_chroma_dry, site$mean_annual_soil_temp_C, site$soil_moisture_subclass), and the Thornthwaite moisture index in site$npdb_cmi; recorded values are never replaced. The ranges are kept in site$npdb_scenario (a second call adds to them); a pedon with no site$id, or one not in climate, gets no climate. benchmark_npdb classifies such a pedon at every combination of the ends of its ranges and counts a class as decided only where they all give it; otherwise the result is provisional.

Usage

npdb_scenario(pedons, climate = NULL, dry_colour = NULL)

Arguments

pedons

A list of PedonRecord from load_npdb_pedons.

climate

A data frame from npdb_soil_climate (its id matching site$id), or NULL.

dry_colour

A npdb_dry_colour_model, or NULL.

Value

The pedons (copies), with the estimates.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
peds <- load_npdb_pedons("path/to/npdb_v3_csv")
nm <- fetch_aafc_normals(vapply(peds, function(p) p$site$lat, 0),
                         vapply(peds, function(p) p$site$lon, 0),
                         id = names(peds))
sc <- npdb_scenario(peds, climate = npdb_soil_climate(nm),
                    dry_colour = npdb_dry_colour_model(peds))
benchmark_npdb(sc, level = "order", set_aside = character(0))
} # }
